sentences.en: Our company offers flexitime to help employees balance work and family life.
sentences.zh: 我们公司提供弹性工作制，帮助员工平衡工作和家庭生活。

sentences.en: She loves the flexitime system because she can adjust her working hours around school pickup times.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢弹性工作制，因为她可以调整自己的工作时间来应对接孩子放学的时间。

sentences.en: The IT department switched to a flexitime schedule this month, which has improved everyone's productivity.
sentences.zh: 这个月IT部门改为弹性工作制度，这提高了每个人的生产力。
